intent.text:
fix: address all gate-review findings blocking the kimchi branch push
The push of branch kimchi was blocked by the pre-push review on
pre-existing defects (3 high, 6 medium, 11 low). This commit fixes every
finding; verified by the full suite matching the pristine baseline plus
~60 new regression assertions.

extensions/review-gate-deny.ts (3 high + 1 low):
- deny ALL leading VAR=value assignments: GIT_CONFIG_*/GIT_DIR/
  GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_PAGER injection no longer escapes the sandbox
- remove sed from the allowlist (script 'w' writes files; GNU sed
  e/s///e executes shell -- Turing-complete script language)
- deny git --output=<path>/-o in checkGit's post-verb loop (the exact
  exfiltration vector 0.6.0 was built to stop)
- add '<' to REDIRECT_OPS so `wc -l < file` parses as documented

hooks/sh/gate-hook.sh + scripts/gate-hook.sh:
- '#' now skips to the next newline instead of breaking tokenization
  (classifies commands on following lines again)
- eval handles the unquoted multi-word form; the old case arm was
  additionally unreachable, so even quoted evals never recursed
- prefilter tests a de-spliced payload copy, seeing through
  `git pu""sh` status to real pushes (quote-splice bypass)
- nonzero gate exit without a verdict now emits the ps1's deny JSON
  instead of dying silently under pipefail (non-blocking error path)

install/uninstall scripts:
- resolve GIT_COMMON_DIR; install pre-push to the common hooks dir when
  inside a linked worktree; uninstall sweeps per-worktree + common dirs
  (marker-only removal preserved)

ocr modules: forge scrubs GIT_TRACE* (sibling pattern) and returns
"unresolved" with the forge tier skipped for non-gh/gl origins; ocr_index
uses prefix-check normalization (root dotfiles no longer mangled) and
emits the couple-cap warning with an early producer break; ocr_impact
_sig filters comment/blank lines (no false signature changes) and exports
the shared name_matches helper (forge + collectors delegate);
ocr_demands schema pattern
